name: Hesperian-Novena
description: An ocean of dust without banks. At the edge of sight, past impact-scarred wastelands, mirage-cities rise and collapse by noon, and the light turns brutal and white.

The air carries ozone and crushed stone, and sound behaves strangely: footsteps crack loud, then die without echo. At night the temperature drops fast enough to hear the rock tick as it contracts. Glass-bladed grasses chime across the plains whenever the wind finds its voice.
Instruments disagree about the spatial rift remnant: mass reads one value, inertia another. Probes sent in return transmitting their own launch signals, timestamped hours early.
The charts mark this world in cautious amber. Those who ignore the marking tend to come back rich, changed, or not at all.
